item.title: Future Luxton Fairgrounds revitalization dependent on more volunteers
item.description: The Metchosin Farmers' Institute is looking to give the historic Luxton Fairgrounds a facelift, however revitalization efforts are dependent on more volunteers.

item.title: 'We still don't know': Questions remain 20 years after Queen of the North sinking, says TSB head investigator
item.description: Reflecting on the fatal sinking of the MV Queen of the North, the former head of major investigations for the Transportation Safety Board says many lessons were learned.

item.title: B.C. mulls changes to weaken DRIPA, shares secret document with First Nations leaders
item.description: B.C. Premier David Eby's government is considering amendments that would weaken a landmark reconciliation law that says the province will take "all measures" to align the rights of Indigenous Peoples with existing provincial legislation.

item.title: B.C. avalanches kill four skiers in deadly backcountry weekend
item.description: Police say three heli-skiers were killed on Sunday when they were caught in an avalanche north of Terrace, B.C., while another skier died in a separate slide near the Alaska border.

item.title: BC Ferries cancels sailings between Vancouver, Victoria due to mechanical issue
item.description: BC Ferries cancelled two sailings between Vancouver and Victoria on Tuesday morning, and say more are at risk of cancellation, due to a mechanical issue with one of its vessels.

item.title: Avalanche safety urged by WorkSafeBC after four skiers killed
item.description: British Columbia's Workers' Compensation Board is urging employers to ensure their employees' safety when working in avalanche terrain, after four deaths in two separate slides over the weekend.

item.title: 'Hoodie-gate': Is David Eby qualified as fashion police after dressing down B.C. MLA?
item.description: Eby thrust political attire onto the agenda this month when he dressed down Opposition legislature member Gavin Dew for wearing a grey hoodie as he voted remotely on a private member's bill.

item.title: Quamichan Lake pilot project being installed to address permanent beach advisory in place for 11 years
item.description: North Cowichan is installing equipment for a pilot project in hopes it will address the water quality issues that has put Quamichan Lake under a permanent beach advisory for 11 years.

item.title: Air Canada plane crash at New York airport may add to travel fears: psychologist
item.description: After the fatal Air Canada plane collision at a New York City airport on Sunday, travellers may experience an initial spike in anxiety.

item.title: Chance the Rapper, Modest Mouse to headline Phillips Backyard music festival
item.description: Popular Victoria music festival Phillips Backyard has announced headliners for this year's event, including some big name acts.

item.title: Man in North Cowichan taken to hospital with serious injuries following assault Friday: RCMP
item.description: North Cowichan/Duncan RCMP is asking anyone who witnessed a serious assault Friday night to come forward.

item.title: Rally held outside N.S. RCMP detachment to demand answers about two missing children
item.description: Under a cloudless sky in central Nova Scotia, about 50 people gathered outside an RCMP detachment Saturday to demand answers about the disappearance of two young children exactly one year ago.

item.title: Victoria Police are searching for a missing elderly man
item.description: The Victoria Police Department is asking the public help find an elderly man with dementia last seen Saturday after leaving his care facility.

item.title: Alberni Pacific Rail celebrates extension of usable rail line Saturday
item.description: Alberni Pacific Rail along with its partners cut a ribbon marking an extension of its usable rail line before the upcoming tourist season

item.title: VIBE: Nashville band makes a tour stop in Victoria this week
item.description: This week’s featured hot ticket items for the weekend and beyond. Brought to you by CHEK Arts &amp;amp; Entertainment producer Steve Grebanier.
